name: Bottles
description: Tier C remains appropriate for the observed component and dependency channel: remote catalog data selects downloadable files, a supplied value is compared locally, and the resulting component or installer is used. The source corrects the algorithm from SHA256 to MD5 and shows a checksum bypass, while it does not establish a signed catalog or the Flatpak packaging boundary. Those are claim and scope corrections rather than evidence for a stronger or weaker project wide tier.
limitations: Snapshot is the newly retrieved default branch at commit 29032bf3084f78c900777d188e7286f8f7280aeb, not the original study checkout; released behavior may differ.
The reviewed source does not authenticate the YAML catalog or establish how Flatpak distributes the application itself.
This review covers component/dependency downloads and execution paths; it does not establish behavior of every Bottles channel or release artifact.
